entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: A magical shield around Ulgrotha erected in 3580 AR by Feroz to keep planeswalkers away; it collapsed in 3800 AR.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker and husband of Serra who cast the Ban around Ulgrotha and died in a mana surge.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Wife of Feroz who helped create the Ban; her artifact was studied for the barrier.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane sealed off by the Ban.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A planeswalker whose arrival harmed Ulgrotha's balance.

entities.name: Anaba minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs whose mural history was destroyed.

entities.name: Serra's Isle
entities.description: Where Feroz and Serra worked on the Ban.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A Force of Nature made manifest thanks to the Ban.

events.summary: Taysir's arrival banishes Sandruu and destroys the Anaba minotaurs' mural history, prompting Feroz and Serra to act.
events.quote: Feroz and his wife Serra decided it was time to do something

events.summary: Feroz and Serra study and labor for nearly a year on Serra's Isle, then on the solstice Feroz casts the Ban, sealing Ulgrotha off.
events.quote: Feroz cast a powerful spell, his Ban, that sealed Ulgrotha off from the other planes.

events.summary: The Ban succeeds, hiding Ulgrotha for years; the Great Wood flourishes and Autumn Willow manifests.
events.quote: the Great Wood flourished and the Force of Nature called Autumn Willow was made manifest

events.summary: A wild mana surge during an experiment kills Feroz and the Ban begins to unravel, leaving Ulgrotha prey to planeswalkers again.
events.quote: Without its maker, the Ban slowly started to unravel
